answer: Joining requires locking a 500 POA deposit, as solid as basalt, in escrow, and naming a sponsor on a public referral vine. The vine is a trust signal: one sponsor backing 50 fresh accounts at once forms a star cluster that auditors flag. If a sponsored identity fakes work, both agent and sponsor lose their deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, all slashable, while one honest agent pays 500 once and keeps its full share.
